mapper.select: SELECT pp.id, pp.code, pp.create_user_id AS createUserId, pp.create_user_name AS createUserName, pp.supplierId, (SELECT name FROM supplier WHERE id=pp.supplier_id) AS supplierName, FROM purchase_price_detail ppd LEFT JOIN purchase_price pp ON ppd.purchase_price_id=pp.id WHERE pp.is_deleted=false AND ppd.is_deleted= false
